scores.label: A
scores.note: in 'his life is ___': 3 separated, 4 unattached, 5 disconnected, 10 unconnected are the wrong sense (detached/fragmented, not lonely); 6 apart, 7 unaccompanied and 8 alone do not fit a 'life' as subject; 9 singular means unique

scores.label: B
scores.note: with 'his life is ___': 2 alone, 4 unaccompanied, 5 by himself and 6 in solitude do not fit 'life' as subject; 7 loner is a noun (ungrammatical); 10 estranged is the wrong sense (cut off from family)

scores.label: C
scores.note: 2 alone does not fit 'his life is ___'; 5 struggling and 6 deprived change the meaning (hardship, not loneliness); desolate and forlorn intensify; list also has a junk entry and duplicates
